vocabulary.Shipped: Implemented in the repository with a usable local contract.
vocabulary.Preview: Implemented or integrating in this branch; public compatibility may still change.
vocabulary.Planned: Accepted direction without a complete implementation in this branch.
vocabulary.Excluded: Explicitly outside the current product or trust model.

features.name: SQLite-WAL lifecycle authority
features.notes: Claims, leases, events, proof validation, and derived status remain local to one database.

features.name: coord CLI
features.notes: Core lifecycle and board commands.

features.name: Python coordination API
features.notes: Typed in-process access to the same authority.

features.name: MCP stdio server
features.notes: The stdio server and up to 30 tools register, but fresh generic and strict-profile board/preflight both fail closed; no standalone MCP deployment profile is accepted end-to-end.

features.name: coord-mcp executable
features.notes: Branch packaging convenience for the MCP stdio server.

features.name: Local job and run telemetry
features.notes: Library primitives are shipped; command-line convenience remains preview.

features.name: Read-only safety doctor
features.notes: Stable v1 PASS/BLOCKED report for schema, lifecycle, jobs, paths, Git, and opt-in MCP configuration; it never bootstraps or repairs.

features.name: Codex and Claude project skill packages
features.notes: Byte-identical repository packages describe lifecycle, job, and context discipline without granting authority.

features.name: Bounded local-model orchestration
features.notes: Explicit neutral catalog, platform/dependency preflight, advisory claims, and process-held MLX resource locking; real inference is not part of the release receipt.

features.name: Local usage and cost ledger
features.notes: Local hash-chained accounting primitives; no hosted billing or vendor telemetry claim.

features.name: Extraction and publication gate
features.notes: Internal release control for explicit inventory, provenance, privacy patterns, fidelity, and reachable-history checks.

features.name: Bounded context, facts, and full-text retrieval
features.notes: The bounded mechanisms ship, but fresh generic and strict-profile board-backed capsule/lens commands both fail closed; no standalone profile is accepted end-to-end.

features.name: Source-bound dependency and evidence graph views
features.notes: Board, Swarm Mesh, Coordination Map, and Operations Atlas are bounded read models over declared rows and typed relationships. Mesh motion is explicitly live-arrival, stationary replay, or schematic direction; none is a freeform whiteboard, lifecycle writer, or productivity claim.

features.name: Loopback read-only web board
features.notes: Local viewer and snapshot API; no writes and no remote exposure.

features.name: macOS menu-bar and desktop client
features.notes: Clean-room read-only client in branch integration; no distribution claim.

features.name: iOS read-only client
features.notes: Clean-room read-only client in branch integration; no distribution claim.

features.name: Distributed or multi-host coordination
features.notes: The current authority is one local SQLite file.

features.name: Hosted or multi-tenant service
features.notes: No authentication, tenant isolation, or public network service is provided.

features.name: Freeform shared whiteboard
features.notes: Not to be confused with the preview source-bound dependency and evidence graph.

features.name: Rich private-product operations console
features.notes: Product modules, startup atlas, action broker, branded surfaces, and hosted operations remain outside the standalone repository.
